author: A G
text: We are so fortunate that D. E. Mathieu plumbing came to us by recommendation. They have helped us out with a few plumbing issues over the years, and the service has always been outstanding. They are fair, honest, and do excellent quality work. Plus, more than once they have been able to help us on an urgent basis. Highly recommend!

author: Lorri
text:
This was my first experience with D.E. Mathieu Plumbing. From my initial phone call to them to completion of the replacement of my ejector pump, Don and his son were prompt, professional and extremely knowledgeable.  During the installation they were very meticulous with keeping everything clean by laying drop cloths; no mess at all! Their pricing was fair and the quality of work is exceptional! I will be using them in the future for my plumbing needs!
Thank you!

author: Xinyi Jiang
text: Don and Andy are very respectful and reliable! I’ve learned a lot from them not only about plumbing, but to be a better me. They are knowledgeable and patient when solving problems and never complain. Their work is perfect and never over charge. I am inspired by them! Best wishes to Don and Andy and their family!

author: christina roenna
text: I moved to Warrenville in 2012 and have used D E Mathieu for sump pump, faucet, garbage disposal removal, leaking gas line to fireplace, sewer pump. Always great service and very expedient when I’ve had an emergent issue. Highly recommend Don! Support local businesses 💛

author: Dave Chiros
text: Don arrived right on time. He completed the task quickly and efficiently. He’s also incredibly kind and personable. 10/10 would hire him again
